summary: Ukraine's air defense shot down 114 of 147 Russian attack UAVs, with 29 UAVs hitting 15 locations, showcasing strong counter-UAV performance. Russian forces intensified attacks on Ukrainian logistics and infrastructure, destroying a Ukrposhta depot in Pavlohrad and striking energy facilities in Zaporizhzhia, disrupting supply lines. Ukraine is advancing its own missile defense, negotiating PAC‑2/3 missiles for Patriot systems and receiving Norwegian aid.
key_points: Ukraine's air defense successfully intercepted 114 of 147 Russian attack UAVs, with 29 UAVs striking 15 locations across multiple regions, damaging postal, school, residential, and administrative buildings and reducing the threat to civilian infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/71821, @UkraineNow/83267)
Russian forces destroyed a sorting depot and mobile unit base of Ukrposhta in Pavlohrad, killing two employees and wounding a third, disrupting logistics. (Source: @eRadarrua/104268)
Russian Geranium drones struck three dry cargo ships carrying military cargo in the Black Sea, impacting maritime supply lines. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32257)
Russian S‑400 and Tsirkon missiles are being used against ground targets, indicating a shift due to limited Iskander missile supply. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32247)

Norway pledged to supply air defense equipment to Ukraine, while Ukraine negotiates PAC‑2 and PAC‑3 missiles for Patriot systems, enhancing air defense. (Source: @UkraineNow/83261, @ukr_leaks_eng/32245)

Russian tactical aviation launched guided bombs toward Donetsk and Sum regions, and UAVs were observed over Slavyansk and Donetsk, increasing pressure on the eastern front. (Source: @kpszsu/71800, @kpszsu/71804)
Russian forces destroyed three cargo trucks carrying Ukrainian forces in the Black Sea, affecting supply chains. (Source: @tass_agency/389127)
Russian forces destroyed three cars and three robotic complexes of Ukrainian forces, indicating continued pressure on Ukrainian ground assets. (Source: @tass_agency/389144)
